item.title: 首席执行官在工业现场被操作叉车的工人杀死
item.description:
📝 因违反安全规定而被罚款的公司在 You 去世后，OSHA 对 HL-GA Battery Company、SBY America、Beyond Iron Construction 和 Steel Brothers Development 展开了调查。 Beyond Iron Construction 收到了最大一笔罚款，为 16,550 美元。据HL-GA电池公司发言人称，SBY America和Beyond Iron Construction均未在施工现场签订合同。
🔤 Original: CEO killed at industrial site by worker operating forklift
🔗 Read more: https://www.12onyourside.com/2025/12/23/ceo-killed-industrial-site-by-worker-operating-forklift-while-talking-phone-osha-report-shows/
